Facility Inventory & Condition Assessmen.justification: Comprehensive district-wide inventory including detailed site plans, building sizes, ages, portables, and specialized spaces; robust condition assessment covering HVAC, plumbing, roofs, electrical, lighting, technology infrastructure, and accessibility; connects condition data to student outcomes and integrates short- and long-term needs into capital planning (Ch.4-5, 10-13, 20-22).

Enrollment & Capacity Planning.justification: Provides detailed enrollment projections through 2030-31 with methodology explained; includes capacity utilization data by site and grade with square footage and classroom loading; links projections to specific facility actions including portable removal, new elementary school opening, boundary changes, and capacity balancing strategies (Ch.6-9, 20-23, 30).

Educational Alignment.justification: Educational alignment is a core organizing principle with a comprehensive district-wide educational specifications document; detailed analysis of how facilities support multiple programs including TK, CTE, special education, STEM, collaborative learning, and technology integration; facility projects directly respond to educational goals and program needs (Ch.22-36).

Outdoor Spaces & Greening.justification: Includes data and analysis of outdoor spaces with references to playgrounds, plazas, quads, and green spaces; identifies strategies for improvement such as shade structures, outdoor classrooms, and expanded play areas; mentions connections between greening and wellness but lacks districtwide data on green surface coverage or comprehensive climate resilience framing (Ch.6, 15, 19, 31-32).

Climate Risk & Mitigation.justification: Acknowledges climate change impacts broadly and references some strategies such as shade structures and site improvements; however, lacks detailed climate risk assessment, frequency or intensity data, and comprehensive district-wide mitigation strategies; climate readiness is not a central theme (No explicit detailed climate risk or mitigation sections found).

Energy Efficiency & Resilience.justification: Mentions energy efficiency projects such as HVAC upgrades and lighting improvements; lacks comprehensive energy use data, detailed resilience strategies, or references to state mandates like Title 24 or Zero Net Energy goals; no detailed discussion of electrification or decarbonization (No detailed energy baseline or resilience plan found).

Financial Plan & Capital Strategy.justification: Provides itemized cost estimates and a prioritization framework linking projects to safety, modernization, and capacity balancing; identifies funding sources including bonds and state programs; discusses project phasing and long-term sustainability considerations though not comprehensively detailed (Ch.10-11, 30).
